title: The skin drop ends in 90 seconds
scenario: A live stream says the first 500 viewers who connect their game account will get a rare skin. A timer is counting down and chat messages are full of people posting “got it!”

answers.A: Connect the account because the stream is live and other viewers say it worked.
answers.B: Check the game’s official news or store for the promotion before connecting your account.
answers.C: Ask a trusted friend to verify the promotion independently while you stay off the link.

explanation: Live chat and countdowns can be faked or botted. Account-linking permissions can give away more than a skin is worth.
proTip: Rare loot is not worth rare access to your account.
